## Summary

Anniversary thread: a year ago Nigel quit his job to trade full-time and immerse in markets; he started The StratLab as a place to capture his research, and it has grown to **975 subscribers** — roughly the 1k mark. Attached photo (unopened) presumably the milestone chart.

## Why it matters

- **Source-tracking, not strategy-tracking.** The StratLab is one of the systematic-trading newsletters whose research the vault already samples via Twitter shares; crossing ~1k subscribers is a durability signal for the source (more likely to keep publishing), nothing more.
- **Skepticism gates:** subscriber count is a business metric, not evidence of edge; the truncated tail may contain an offer or product push — capture-first, judge later. No task warranted.
